key_insight: The FrontierOR Challenge tests whether LLM agents can design scalable optimization algorithms across diverse operations research problems.
engineering_relevance: Successful agentic workflows could reduce the specialist effort needed to develop routing, scheduling, and network design algorithms.
method: Build agents that design, test, and improve optimization algorithms across problems.
Stage 1 releases 60 audited problems; Stage 2 adds new problems with unseen instances.
Evaluate separately in a network-isolated, open-source-only Main track and a timed Self-hosted track allowing any software.
evidence_signal: In the benchmark’s one-shot evaluation, the strongest model achieves an objective within 1% of Gurobi’s with no slower runtime on only 39% of large instances.
watch_item: This is a challenge proposal rather than a demonstrated agentic breakthrough; performance on new problems and unseen instances remains to be established.
paper_title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
